action_description: Kept the d660c1aa stage1 gate/up path unchanged and replaced only the down-projection/output stage with a route-parallel grouped GEMM-style kernel over T*TOPK route rows, hidden-column tiles, and split-I scale tiles. The grouped kernel reuses the existing FP4 scale-tiled decode, applies topk_weights, atomically accumulates into an FP32 out_accum buffer, and a finalize kernel converts to bf16 output.
